name: USD Coin
description: Circle's fully reserved US-dollar stablecoin — the canonical USDC on Ethereum, redeemable 1:1 for dollars.
about:
## The canonical dollar stablecoin

USD Coin (USDC) is a fully reserved dollar stablecoin issued by [Circle](https://www.circle.com/usdc). Each USDC is redeemable 1:1 for US dollars held in cash and short-dated US Treasuries, with monthly third-party attestations. USDC uses **6 decimals** — one USDC is 1,000,000 base units.

## Upgradeable, role-based design

This address is a `FiatTokenProxy` delegating to Circle's `FiatTokenV2_2` implementation, so the token's logic can be upgraded by Circle at any time. Operations are split across Circle-controlled roles:

- **Owner** — replaces the other role holders
- **Master minter** — authorizes minters and sets their minting allowances
- **Minters** — mint new USDC as dollars are deposited and burn it on redemption
- **Pauser** — can halt all transfers, approvals, minting, and burning
- **Blacklister** — can freeze individual addresses entirely
- **Rescuer** — can recover ERC-20 tokens accidentally sent to the contract

## Gasless approvals and transfers

USDC supports **EIP-2612 permit** (signature-based approvals) and **EIP-3009 transfer authorizations** (signature-based transfers), letting relayers submit transactions and pay gas on the signer's behalf. Version 2.2 also accepts EIP-1271 signatures from smart contract wallets via the packed-signature variants. `receiveWithAuthorization` can only be submitted by the payee, which protects payments against front-running.

## Compliance controls

Circle can blacklist addresses — a blacklisted address can no longer send, receive, or approve USDC — and can pause the entire token. These controls exist to comply with legal requirements such as sanctions.
risks: Circle can blacklist any address, freezing its USDC entirely
Upgradeable proxy — Circle can replace the token's logic at any time
Circle can pause the token, halting all transfers, approvals, and minting
Fiat-backed — value depends on Circle's reserves and redemption process, not onchain collateral

gasless.label: Gasless Signatures
gasless.description: Signature-based approvals and transfers (EIP-2612 and EIP-3009), typically submitted by relayers.

name.title: Token Name
name.description: The name of the token (USD Coin).

decimals.title: Decimals
decimals.description: Number of decimal places (6 — one USDC is 1,000,000 base units).

totalSupply.title: Total Supply
totalSupply.description: Total USDC in circulation on Ethereum.

increaseAllowance.title: Increase Allowance
increaseAllowance.description: Raise a spender's allowance by an increment — avoids the race condition of resetting an existing approval.

decreaseAllowance.title: Decrease Allowance
decreaseAllowance.description: Lower a spender's allowance by a decrement. Reverts if it exceeds the current allowance.

permit.title: Permit (EIP-2612)
permit.description: Apply an approval signed off-chain by the token holder. Anyone may submit it — typically a relayer paying gas.
permit.intent: Set allowance of {spender} to {value}, signed by {owner}

owner.label: owner
owner.description: The token holder who signed the approval.

deadline.label: deadline
deadline.description: Unix timestamp after which the signature expires.

permit-packed.title: Permit (Packed Signature)
permit-packed.description: Permit variant taking a packed signature. Also accepts EIP-1271 signatures from smart contract wallets.
permit-packed.intent: Set allowance of {spender} to {value}, signed by {owner}

transfer-with-authorization.title: Transfer With Authorization
transfer-with-authorization.description: Execute a USDC transfer signed off-chain by the payer (EIP-3009). Anyone may submit it, e.g. a gasless relayer.
transfer-with-authorization.intent: Transfer {value} from {from} to {to} via signed authorization

validAfter.label: valid after
validAfter.description: Unix time from which the authorization is valid.

validBefore.label: valid before
validBefore.description: Unix time at which the authorization expires.

nonce.label: nonce
nonce.description: Random 32-byte nonce chosen by the payer (not sequential).

transfer-with-authorization-packed.title: Transfer With Authorization (Packed)
transfer-with-authorization-packed.description: Packed-signature variant of Transfer With Authorization. Also accepts EIP-1271 smart wallet signatures.
transfer-with-authorization-packed.intent: Transfer {value} from {from} to {to} via signed authorization

receive-with-authorization.title: Receive With Authorization
receive-with-authorization.description: Pull a USDC payment signed by the payer (EIP-3009). Only the recipient may submit it, preventing front-running.
receive-with-authorization.warning: Only the recipient (to) can submit this transaction.

nonce.label: nonce
nonce.description: Random 32-byte nonce chosen by the payer (not sequential).

receive-with-authorization-packed.title: Receive With Authorization (Packed)
receive-with-authorization-packed.description: Packed-signature variant of Receive With Authorization. Also accepts EIP-1271 smart wallet signatures.
receive-with-authorization-packed.warning: Only the recipient (to) can submit this transaction.

cancel-authorization.title: Cancel Authorization
cancel-authorization.description: Cancel an unused transfer authorization by its nonce, using a cancellation signed by the authorizer.

cancel-authorization-packed.title: Cancel Authorization (Packed)
cancel-authorization-packed.description: Packed-signature variant of Cancel Authorization. Also accepts EIP-1271 smart wallet signatures.

nonces.title: Permit Nonce
nonces.description: The next EIP-2612 permit nonce for an address. Each executed permit increments it.

authorizationState.title: Authorization State
authorizationState.description: Whether an EIP-3009 authorization nonce has already been used or canceled.

mint.title: Mint
mint.description: Create new USDC for a recipient. Restricted to Circle-configured minters, within their minting allowance.
mint.warning: Minter only — reverts for all other callers.

burn.title: Burn
burn.description: Destroy USDC from the caller's own balance. Used by Circle minters when dollars are redeemed.

configureMinter.title: Configure Minter
configureMinter.description: Authorize a minter and set the maximum amount it may mint. Only the master minter.

removeMinter.title: Remove Minter
removeMinter.description: Revoke a minter's authorization entirely. Only the master minter.

minterAllowance.title: Minter Allowance
minterAllowance.description: How much USDC a configured minter may still mint.

isMinter.title: Is Minter
isMinter.description: Check whether an address is a configured minter.

masterMinter.title: Master Minter
masterMinter.description: The Circle-controlled address that configures and removes minters.

blacklist.title: Blacklist Address
blacklist.description: Freeze an address — it can no longer send, receive, or approve USDC. Only the blacklister.

unBlacklist.title: Remove From Blacklist
unBlacklist.description: Unfreeze a previously blacklisted address. Only the blacklister.

isBlacklisted.title: Is Blacklisted
isBlacklisted.description: Check whether an address is currently frozen by Circle.

blacklister.title: Blacklister
blacklister.description: The Circle-controlled address that can freeze and unfreeze accounts.

pause.title: Pause
pause.description: Halt all transfers, approvals, minting, and burning. Only the pauser.

unpause.title: Unpause
unpause.description: Resume normal operation after a pause. Only the pauser.

paused.title: Paused
paused.description: Whether the token is currently paused.

pauser.title: Pauser
pauser.description: The Circle-controlled address that can pause and unpause the token.

owner.title: Owner
owner.description: The contract owner (Circle). Can replace every role holder.

transferOwnership.title: Transfer Ownership
transferOwnership.description: Transfer the owner role to a new address. Only the owner.

updateMasterMinter.title: Update Master Minter
updateMasterMinter.description: Set a new master minter. Only the owner.

updateBlacklister.title: Update Blacklister
updateBlacklister.description: Set a new blacklister. Only the owner.

updatePauser.title: Update Pauser
updatePauser.description: Set a new pauser. Only the owner.

updateRescuer.title: Update Rescuer
updateRescuer.description: Set a new rescuer. Only the owner.

rescueERC20.title: Rescue Tokens
rescueERC20.description: Send ERC-20 tokens stuck in this contract to a recovery address. Only the rescuer.

rescuer.title: Rescuer
rescuer.description: The Circle-controlled address that can recover tokens sent to this contract.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: The fiat currency the token represents (USD).

DOMAIN_SEPARATOR.description: EIP-712 domain separator used for permit and authorization signatures.

initializeV2_1.deprecated: USDC is fully initialized — calling this reverts.

initializeV2_2.deprecated: USDC is fully initialized — calling this reverts.

TransferWithAuthorization.title: Transfer Authorization (EIP-3009)
TransferWithAuthorization.description: Authorize a one-time USDC transfer from your wallet that anyone may submit onchain (e.g. a gasless relayer).
TransferWithAuthorization.warning: Once valid, anyone can execute this transfer. Verify the recipient, amount, and validity window before signing.

value.label: amount
value.description: The exact amount that will be transferred.

nonce.label: nonce
nonce.description: Random 32-byte value; each authorization needs a unique nonce.

ReceiveWithAuthorization.title: Payment Authorization (EIP-3009)
ReceiveWithAuthorization.description: Authorize a payee to pull a one-time USDC payment. Only the payee can submit it onchain.
ReceiveWithAuthorization.warning: The recipient can withdraw the stated amount from your wallet once the authorization becomes valid.

value.label: amount
value.description: The exact amount that will be transferred.

nonce.label: nonce
nonce.description: Random 32-byte value; each authorization needs a unique nonce.

CancelAuthorization.title: Cancel Authorization (EIP-3009)
CancelAuthorization.description: Cancel a signed transfer authorization that has not been used yet.

Mint.description: Emitted when a minter creates new USDC.

Burn.description: Emitted when a minter destroys USDC from its own balance.

MinterConfigured.description: Emitted when a minter is authorized or its minting allowance is updated.

MinterRemoved.description: Emitted when a minter's authorization is revoked.

MasterMinterChanged.description: Emitted when the master minter role is reassigned.

Blacklisted.description: Emitted when an address is frozen by the blacklister.

UnBlacklisted.description: Emitted when an address is removed from the blacklist.

BlacklisterChanged.description: Emitted when the blacklister role is reassigned.

Pause.description: Emitted when the token is paused — all transfers, approvals, and minting halt.

Unpause.description: Emitted when the token resumes normal operation.

PauserChanged.description: Emitted when the pauser role is reassigned.

OwnershipTransferred.description: Emitted when contract ownership moves to a new address.

RescuerChanged.description: Emitted when the rescuer role is reassigned.

AuthorizationUsed.description: Emitted when an EIP-3009 authorization is executed.

AuthorizationCanceled.description: Emitted when an unused EIP-3009 authorization is canceled.

Upgraded.description: Emitted by the proxy when Circle upgrades the implementation contract.

AdminChanged.description: Emitted by the proxy when its admin address changes.
